## Our Practices

![Criminal law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Criminal-Law.jpg)

###### Criminal Law

Criminal law involves prosecuting individuals for committing crimes against society, ranging from minor misdemeanours to serious felonies. It includes the rules and procedures for determining guilt and imposing punishment and the rights of the accused and the victims.

![Corporate Law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Corporate-Law.jpg)

###### Corporate Law

Corporate law involves the legal framework governing corporations’ formation, operation, and dissolution. It includes the laws and regulations related to corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, securities offerings, and other corporate transactions.

![Family Law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/family-law.jpg)

###### Family Law

Family law involves legal issues related to the family unit, such as divorce, child custody, adoption, and domestic violence. It includes the rules and procedures for resolving disputes between family members and protecting the best interests of children involved in these disputes.

![Civil law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/civil-law.jpg)

###### Civil Law

Civil law involves resolving disputes between individuals or organisations, such as contract disputes, property disputes, and personal injury claims. It includes the rules and procedures for bringing a case to court, determining liability, and awarding damages or other relief to the aggrieved party.

![intellectual property law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ipl.jpg)

###### IPR

IPR, or intellectual property law, protects the rights of creators and owners of intangible assets, such as patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets. It includes the rules and procedures for registering, licensing and enforcing these rights in various industries and jurisdictions.

![properity law](https://iconlegalservices.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/properity-law.jpg)

###### Property Law

Property law involves legal issues related to real and personal property, including ownership, transfer, and use. It includes the rules and procedures for buying and selling property, resolving property disputes, and enforcing property rights, such as easements, liens, and leases.
